phase: Step 1 product-boundary change control for unbounded tower, prestige, evolution, rarity, duplicate skills, and weapon gacha
acceptedUserDirections: The tower has no player-visible maximum floor.
A strong-new-game reset is required, using Merchant Saga and Maou 'Sekai no Hanbun Ageru' only as abstract references.
Merchant Saga mechanics may remain selectively, but the heavy merchant-company-chairman identity is removed.
Characters level with coin beyond level 100 and become eligible for ruby evolution at every 100 levels.
Ruby comes from purchases, strong-new-game reset rewards, and rewarded advertisements.
Duplicate characters raise character skill progression.
Weapons have a gacha acquisition route and duplicate-based weapon skill progression.
Characters and weapons use N/R/RR/SR/SSR/UR rarity.
N/R have non-gacha acquisition paths; RR-UR use the gacha route.
Kinoko Legend is an abstract reference for rarity/gacha/skill/evolution structure, not a source to copy.
primaryDesignResolutions: Unbounded means no product-visible hard cap and data-driven generated cycles, not infinite hand-authored content.
Dawn and strong-new-game may not coexist as separate prestige systems; Dawn must merge, rename, or be removed.
Character level and evolution stage are independent axes.
Ruby must have paid/free source ledgers and server-authoritative grants.
Base characters and weapons must be usable before duplicate skill upgrades.
Character and weapon banners are separate.
The existing twelve-screen monetization architecture can absorb the new progression without a thirteenth screen.
The first implementation slice remains Floors 1-10 while Step 1 is reopened.
openP1: The active canonical documents still contain the fixed 100F maximum and 101F prohibition.
The one-line product identity still includes a merchant-company-leader frame.
Dawn, Dawn shards, strong-new-game, and ruby have not been consolidated.
No arbitrary-precision floor/economy representation is sealed.
No final reset loss/retention/reward matrix is sealed.
Ruby evolution cost and free reset income are unvalidated.
Character and weapon duplicate caps and overflow are unset.
The N/R/RR/SR/SSR/UR registry is not yet in PROJECT_STATUS, schemas, or UI contracts.
Weapon gacha conflicts with the current one-slot three-armament contract.
The old 100F and 12,000-scenario simulation plan is insufficient.
The uploaded ChatGPT Project instruction MD is stale for the reopened product scope.
nextAuthorizedWork: Continue collecting user product changes. After the direction set stabilizes, create one consolidated canonical redline and one numbered replacement ChatGPT Project instruction MD; do not repeatedly replace the Project source while requirements are still being supplied.
